narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Twelve thousand divided by a hundred is a hundred twenty, so it takes a hundred twenty days.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But the albatross covers nearly a thousand kilometres in a day, not a hundred.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The divisor is wrong, so the slip is struck out.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble appears with a hundred twenty days; 100 and 1000 are compared; the slip is struck through

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Days are the distance divided by the daily distance.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>A range of speeds gives a range of days.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A slower speed means more days.
removed_beats.on_screen: the words divide appear; the words range in, range out appear; the words slower, more days appear

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip divides by the wrong number and gets a hundred twenty days. The albatross covers nearly a thousand kilometres each day.
